MoQ - Media over QUIC

Media over QUIC (MoQ) ultra-low latency streaming protocol with object-based delivery. Advanced media streaming with Rust WebAssembly optimization.

Features include ultra-low latency streaming, object-based media delivery, adaptive bitrate streaming, CDN integration, multi-device synchronization, and built-in security.

Perfect for live streaming, interactive media applications, real-time gaming, collaborative platforms, and IoT data streams requiring minimal latency.

Advanced network visualization shows publisher-relay-subscriber architecture with real-time statistics including latency, throughput, object counts, and connection metrics.
